snippet.title: Cythera Playthrough Pt  1 1of2
snippet.description: This is the first part of a playthrough of an old Macintosh computer game called Cythera.  More information on the game can be found on the game's website or web board (specifically http://www.ambrosiasw.com/forums/index.php?s=1d14c4fec0f86c519b28cdff955baa77&showtopic=133098 ) on Ambrosia Software.
